ocr_samples: 用件も何もただ遊びに来ただけつれないわねじゃない
そんなに何も警戒しないでしないわよ
ほら里でお菓子も買って来たしお茶でもどうかしら?
translations: I didn’t bring anything with me, just came here to have fun. You can’t really say that I didn’t come for a purpose, right?
Don’t be so worried about nothing.
What’s the purpose of coming here?
Look, I also bought some snacks at the store. How about we have a cup of tea?
